DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Dyserythropoietic Anemia Type I (Heinz body anemia).

The low reticulocyte count (0.8%) and macrocytosis (MCV 100 fL) indicate ineffective erythropoiesis despite significant anemia, while the normal bilirubin and LDH help rule out simple hemolysis. Can you confirm if your baby has had any episodes of jaundice or gallstones, and is there a family history of liver disease or anemia?
